Gemini CLI's home as a user would have it, written from its documentation
(`docs/reference/configuration.md`, `docs/tools/mcp-server.md`,
`docs/reference/policy-engine.md` in github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli) on
2026-11-02, not captured from an installed program. To be replaced by files a
real Gemini CLI wrote, with its version.

`home/` is the agent's home before Fastctx connects it; `identity.json` is who
its files say is logged in.
